description: An INITIALIZE REPLACING item naming more than one category (REPLACING NUMERIC ALPHANUMERIC DATA BY ZERO) - a COBOL-2002 relaxation of a COBOL-85 restriction. §1985:VI.6.17.2 prints the five category words of a REPLACING item in plain braces with no choice indicators, so each item takes one (§1985:IV.2.1.4: "one of the options contained within the braces must be either explicitly specified or implicitly selected"); the ISO/IEC 1989:2002 format (14.8.19.1) encloses the category-name words in braces carrying choice indicators, as §2023:14.9.20.2 does (§2023:5.2.6.4). Read from the printed formats, as the rows of VCR row 7.52 are (kb/Work PB5180). Gated in ONE place, VersionConformancePass.ParseArm.VisitInitializeReplacingItem, at the item's second category word; the 1985 spelling of the same request is one item per category.
display: an INITIALIZE REPLACING item naming more than one category
vcr: VCR Table 7 row 7.52 (d) - the INITIALIZE REPLACING category set, a COBOL-85 restriction read from the printed formats
